title: Balochistan Juvenile Smoking Balochistan Repeal Act 2018

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Juvenile Smoking Balochistan Repeal Act 2018
sections.description:
Short title and Commencement

ACT V OF 2018
ACT V OF 2018
BALOCHISTAN JUVENILE SMOKING
(BALOCHISTAN REPEAL) ACT, 2018
An Act to repeal the Balochistan Juvenile Smoking
Ordinance, 1959 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. XII of 1959), in its application
to province of Balochistan
[Gazette of Balochistan
Extraordinary,
11th May, 2018]
No.PAB/Legis;V(20)/2018,
dated 11.5.2018.---The Balochistan
Juvenile Smoking (Balochistan Repeal) Bill, 2018 (Bill No.20 of 2018), having
been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 30th April, 2018 and
assented to by the Governor Balochistan, on 10th May, 2018 is hereby published
as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to repeal the
Balochistan Juvenile Smoking Ordinance, 1959 (West Pakistan Ordinance No. XII
of 1959), in its application to the province of Balochistan.
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and Commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Juvenile Smoking (Balochistan Repeal) Act,
2018.
(2) It shall
come into force at one.
